summary: Frontend-only regression for the new SkyForge cinematic cinemagraph hero + nav/contact/waitlist regressions. All targeted checks PASS. /skyforge loads (200) and renders: skyforge-cinemagraph, skyforge-live-badge ('SURVEY IN PROGRESS'), skyforge-telemetry, skyforge-signal-count, skyforge-cta-demo, skyforge-back-systems, skyforge-patent-badge, skyforge-cta-contact. The SIGNALS counter increments over ~3s (observed 1247 -> 1255). CTA 'Request a demo' navigates to /contact. 'All systems' navigates to /products. Below-hero sections all render (RASP pillars, propulsion, MgO/QFI, roadmap v1.0-v3.0, founder quote, bottom CTA). No 'Flying Magnetometer' legacy text anywhere in the page HTML. NavBar links Home/Systems/SkyForge/About/Contact all resolve to correct routes. Contact form (/contact) POST /api/contact returns 200 and contact-success testid is shown. Waitlist on Home page opens, accepts email, POST /api/waitlist returns 200, and shows the 'You're on the list' confirmation state.
critical_code_review_comments: Cinemagraph is purely CSS (Ken Burns + radar sweep + breathing survey glow + rising motes + scroll parallax). No perf issues observed; animations use transform/opacity which is GPU-friendly. Consider prefers-reduced-motion guard if not already present in globals.css to respect a11y.
SIGNALS counter is driven by setInterval in a client component; ensure the interval is cleared on unmount (component unmount cleanup) to avoid stray timers if user navigates via SPA link.
test_credentials: None required. Used qa@example.com for contact, qa+wait@example.com for waitlist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_10 verified new SkyForge cinemagraph hero at http://localhost:3000/skyforge. Key testids: skyforge-cinemagraph, skyforge-live-badge, skyforge-telemetry, skyforge-signal-count (increments on interval), skyforge-cta-demo (->/contact), skyforge-back-systems (->/products), skyforge-patent-badge, skyforge-cta-contact. Contact form testids: contact-input-name/email/message, contact-submit, contact-success. Waitlist uses button 'Notify me' opening inline capture; success shows 'You're on the list'. All nav links work via role=link exact-name. No 'Flying Magnetometer' string in DOM.
